{{Short description|Italian mathematician}}
{{Orphan|date=December 2024}}

[[File:Barberino_Benici_-_Aritmetica_prattica,_1697_-_4783464.tif|thumb|''Aritmetica prattica'' (1697)]]

'''Francesco Barberino Benici''' (3 December 1642 – 26 September 1702) was an [[Italians|Italian]] [[mathematician]].<ref>{{Cite web|language=it|url=https://opac.sbn.it/risultati-autori/-/opac-autori/detail/PALV069975|title=Barberino Benici, Francesco|publisher=[[OPAC SBN]]|access-date=30 September 2024}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|language=it|url=https://catalogue.beic.it/discovery/fulldisplay?docid=alma9926274304741&context=L&vid=39BEIC_INST:39BEIC_INST&lang=it&search_scope=Library&adaptor=Local%20Search%20Engine&tab=LibraryCatalog&query=any,contains,Francesco%20Barberino%20Benici&offset=0|title=Aritmetica prattica|publisher=[[Biblioteca europea di informazione e cultura|BEIC]]|access-date=30 September 2024}}</ref>

He was among the first popularizers of [[mathematics]] for [[shopkeeper]]s, along with [[Elia Del Re]], [[Christopher Clavius]], and  [[Domenico Griminelli]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://catalog.hathitrust.org/Record/000207208|title=Catalog Record: Aritmetica, e geometria prattica|publisher=[[HathiTrust]]}}</ref>
